utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re thinking of helping, they could probably use more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that right? I’d like to hear that confirmed before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Fair enough—I’m just passing along what I’ve heard around the block, not claiming I saw the count myself. If you want, I can ask at the community center and get you a solid update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great—thanks, Vik. I’ll try to keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem—I’ll keep mentioning it around the block and make sure folks remember the date.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just help spreading the word and maybe dropping off a few supplies if you can. I’ll let you know what else comes up while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can spread the word and drop off supplies if needed. Just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re trying to get a few things fixed up around the block. I should probably stop by and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, they’re still figuring out what’s needed. If you stop by, I can check what supplies are short too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot, thanks. I’ll swing by and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send you the repair drive details now so we can line it up with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them over and I’ll check the pickup window. Then I can see what I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what time are we meeting for the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—let’s meet at 10 AM by the community shed. Just bring a pair of work gloves and maybe a screwdriver if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 AM by the community shed works for me. I’ll bring gloves and a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive around the neighborhood. Want me to add your name if you’re helping?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please add my name—but I can only help if the timing works out. Let me know what I’d be responsible for.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put your name down and ask what time slots are best. I can also see if there’s a simple job like checking tools or greeting folks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — the repair drive. I haven’t heard the latest, so I’m happy to help if there’s something I should know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that’d be wonderful. I’m still lining up the list of fixes, so I’ll share the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date and what kind of repairs you’re planning for the drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — it’s on Saturday the 15th, and we’re focusing on small home repairs like fixing loose shelves, patching minor leaks, and tightening doors. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — Saturday the 15th, with shelves, leaks, and doors. I’ve got it noted and I’ll help with those repairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still thinking it over, honestly. If I can help a little, I will.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, Uli — even a little help would be great. Just let me know if you decide to join.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will. I just need a bit more time to sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you’re looking for.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a screwdriver set and a wrench I could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both you can borrow. Swing by when you’re ready, and I’ll set them aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can keep an eye on where it’s being held. Just let me know the details and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal. I’ll send you the details when I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — once you send them, I’ll note the location and keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand and some tools if needed—what kind of repairs are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. It’s mostly a few small fixes around the place—nothing too big, but a second pair of hands would really help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all—I’m happy to help with the small stuff. Just let me know when you want me over, and I’ll bring a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact time, where we’re meeting, and what supplies are still needed first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, that makes sense. Can you confirm the exact time and meeting spot, and then I’ll tell you what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure—just send me the exact time and meeting spot, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help spread the word about the repair drive and link up folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Jules — thank you. I’ll send you the details so you can share them around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, send them over and I’ll pass them along to the neighbors who’d be interested.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we still need for the repair drive. Let me know what’s already been gathered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo. I’m joining a bit late, but I can check what’s already been dropped off and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — just tell me what’s in so far, and I’ll make a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and a few supplies, so it’s actually coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’ll try to swing by after school pickup and drop off anything we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Faye—anything you can spare will help. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in. Just tell me where to drop it off and when.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — you can drop everything off at my porch on Saturday between 10 and 1. I’ll sort it and get it to the repair team.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring it by Saturday between 10 and 1.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort the broken chairs and a couple of loose shelves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That would be a huge help, Leo — thanks. I’ll bring the labels and tools so we can get them sorted quickly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to add your name or pass along an invite?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please pass along the invite—I’d appreciate the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll pass it along and send the details your way too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure where the repair drive is headed yet, but I can keep an eye on it and let you know if I spot any updates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Just let me know when you hear anything, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep checking for updates and let you know as soon as I spot where it’s headed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I bring my tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on. Could you bring your tools around 10, just to make sure we have everything ready?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll bring them around 10. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive got a good bit of support already. If you need, I can help spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be really kind of you, Ira—thank you. I’ve already got a few things set up, but extra word-of-mouth would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—I’ll mention it to folks when I’m out today and point them your way.
